reason: Checked against src/game.6502 1997-2031 and build/strykers.lst. moved_on/walk_beyond_steps are referenced only inside walk_column (grep of src and tools); walk_column's only entry is JSR at &1AF8. Hoisting d = viewport_right_low - mover_x_low and STA walk_d (&9D) above the n - 1 sum is safe: the moved instructions read sprite_column_count,X (bank 4, already paged), movers_x_low,Y and mover_x_low (&F8), none aliasing &9D, and nothing writes them in between; &9D is walk_column's scratch (zp.6502), already written here by the old code. CMP walk_d (C5, 2 bytes, 3 cycles) with A = X = n - 1 sets C and Z exactly as CPX walk_d; N/V are unread before ADC overwrites them. Both entries to moved_on then have A = n - 1, C = 0, as TXA gave; the n - 1 > d path reloads A before use. SKIP 1 sits after the always-taken BNE steps_known (unreachable; the same idiom as SKIP 5/2/9 elsewhere in game.6502), so the ADC at &1B3B and everything after keep their addresses; BCC moved_on's target moves &1B3A -> &1B3B, same page &1B (also in gameplay builds without the 13-byte SKIP, and in page-shifted bench builds). No ROMSEL/ANDY/ACCCON change, no raster timing, no generated source or table touched, no room needed. Saves the TXA: 2 cycles on both moved_on paths, 0 bytes.
